nvitk.gui.core.spatial¶

Spatial metadata and orientation helpers for Napari layers.

4x4 transform used by the Napari layer (voxel index → world).

nvitk.gui.core.spatial.layer_spacing(layer: Any) → tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None¶

Voxel spacing in layer axis order.

Prefer file metadata / affine column norms over Napari scale. When a layer is displayed with an affine, Napari typically leaves scale at (1,1,1), which must not override the real mm spacing.

nvitk.gui.core.spatial.view_direction_into_scene(layer: Any, view_direction: Any, event: Any | None = None) → numpy.ndarray | None¶

Unit view ray direction in data space, from the camera through the scene.

Napari dims.view_direction points from the scene toward the camera; the pick ray uses the opposite (into the volume).

nvitk.gui.core.spatial.align_mask_to_reference_layer(mask_layer: Any, reference_layer: Any, mask_data=None, *, order=0) → tuple[nvitk.types.Image, nvitk.types.Image, bool]¶

Return (reference_image, mask_on_reference_grid, was_resampled).

When shapes or affines differ, resamples the mask onto the reference grid (same convention as align() mask_to_raw).
